votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Smethurst to approve the ordinance amending the Dinosaur Crossing Planned Development Commercial zone in order to amend the master sign plan. votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)
